type: anIdentificationType number: anIdentificationNumber

		detect: [ :anIdentificationClass | anIdentificationClass isFor: anIdentificationType ]
		ifNone: [ self error: self invalidTypeErrorDescription ]

assertIsValidNumber: anIdentificationNumber

	(self isValidNumber: anIdentificationNumber) ifFalse: [ self error: self invalidNumberErrorDescription ]

isOfType: anIdentificationType number: anIdentificationNumber

	^self type = anIdentificationType and: [ number = anIdentificationNumber ]

isValidNumber: anIdentificationNumber

	^anIdentificationNumber isAllDigits and: [ anIdentificationNumber asNumber between: 1 and: 99999999 ]

isValidNumber: anIdentificationNumber

	^(self hasValidSize: anIdentificationNumber)
		and: [ (self hasDashesInPlace: anIdentificationNumber)
		and: [ (self hasValidHeader: anIdentificationNumber)
		and: [ self hasValidDigits: anIdentificationNumber ]]]

hasDashesInPlace: anIdentificationNumber

	^anIdentificationNumber third = $- and: [ anIdentificationNumber penultimate = $- ]

hasValidDigits: anIdentificationNumber

	^anIdentificationNumber last isDigit and: [ (anIdentificationNumber copyFrom: 4 to: anIdentificationNumber size - 2) isAllDigits ]

from: aZipCodeText

	^(self subclassFor: aZipCodeText) code: aZipCodeText

code: aZipCodeText

	self assertIsValid: aZipCodeText.

	^self new initializeCode: aZipCodeText

subclassFor: aZipCodeText

	^self subclasses
		detect: [ :aZipCodeClass | aZipCodeClass canRepresent: aZipCodeText ]
		ifNone: [ self error: self invalidTypeErrorDescription ]

assertIsValid: aZipCodeText

	(self isValid: aZipCodeText) ifFalse: [ self error: self invalidFormatErrorDescription ]

isValid: aZipCodeText

	^aZipCodeText isAllDigits and: [ aZipCodeText asNumber between: 1000 and: 9999 ]

isValid: aZipCodeText

	^aZipCodeText size = 8
		and: [ (OldZipCode isValid: (aZipCodeText copyFrom: 2 to: 5))
		and: [ (aZipCodeText last: 3) isAllLetters ]]
